Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. - update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class Poi extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = [
        'category_id', 'name', 'description', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'address',
        'price_range', 'tags', 'operating_hours', 'photo_url', 'source_type',
        'transit_friendliness_score', 'data_source_id'
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'latitude' => 'decimal:7',
            'longitude' => 'decimal:7',
            'tags' => 'array',
        ];
    }

    public function category(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Category::class);
    }

    public function dataSource(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(DataSource::class);
    }

    public function transitStops(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(TransitStop::class, 'poi_transit_stops')
            ->using(PoiTransitStop::class)
            ->withPivot('distance_meters', 'walking_minutes');
    }

    public function surveyActivities(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(SurveyActivity::class);
    }

    public function itineraryItems(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(ItineraryItem::class);
    }
}

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class Category extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = ['name', 'slug', 'type', 'icon'];

    public function pois(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(Poi::class);
    }
}

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Poi;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class PoiController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $query = Poi::with('category', 'dataSource', 'transitStops');

        if ($category = $request->query('category')) {
            $query->whereHas('category', fn($q) => $q->where('slug', $category));
        }
        if ($priceRange = $request->query('price_range')) {
            $query->where('price_range', $priceRange);
        }
        if ($nearStopId = $request->query('near_stop_id')) {
            $maxDistance = $request->query('max_distance', 500);
            $query->whereHas('transitStops', fn($q) => $q->where('transit_stop_id', $nearStopId)
                ->where('distance_meters', '<=', (int)$maxDistance));
        }
        $query->when($request->tags, fn($q, $t) => $q->where(function($q) use ($t) {
            foreach (explode(',', $t) as $tag) {
                $q->whereJsonContains('tags', trim($tag));
            }
        }));
        // Bounding box filter
        if ($bbox = $request->query('bbox')) {
            [$minLng, $minLat, $maxLng, $maxLat] = explode(',', $bbox);
            $query->whereBetween('longitude', [(float)$minLng, (float)$maxLng])
                  ->whereBetween('latitude', [(float)$minLat, (float)$maxLat]);
        }

        $perPage = $request->query('per_page', 50);
        $pois = $query->paginate(min((int)$perPage, 200));

        // Add nearest_stop for each POI
        $pois->through(function ($poi) {
            $poi->nearest_stop = $this->getNearestStop($poi);
            return $poi;
        });

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $pois->items(),
            'meta' => ['pagination' => [
                'page' => $pois->currentPage(),
                'per_page' => $pois->perPage(),
                'total' => $pois->total(),
            ]],
        ]);
    }

    public function show(int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $poi = Poi::with(['category', 'dataSource', 'transitStops' => function ($q) {
            $q->orderByPivot('distance_meters')->limit(3);
        }])->find($id);

        if (!$poi) {
            return response()->json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'POI tidak ditemukan'], 404);
        }

        $poi->nearest_stop = $this->getNearestStop($poi);

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $poi]);
    }

    private function getNearestStop($poi): ?array
    {
        $stop = $poi->transitStops->sortBy('pivot.distance_meters')->first();

        if (!$stop) {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            'id' => $stop->id,
            'name' => $stop->name,
            'distance_meters' => (int) $stop->pivot->distance_meters,
            'walking_minutes' => (int) $stop->pivot->walking_minutes,
            'latitude' => (float) $stop->latitude,
            'longitude' => (float) $stop->longitude,
        ];
    }
}

# PHP Security

> This file extends [common/security.md](../common/security.md) with PHP specific content.

## Input and Output

- Validate request input at the framework boundary (`FormRequest`, Symfony Validator, or explicit DTO validation).
- Escape output in templates by default; treat raw HTML rendering as an exception that must be justified.
- Never trust query params, cookies, headers, or uploaded file metadata without validation.

## Database Safety

- Use prepared statements (`PDO`, Doctrine, Eloquent query builder) for all dynamic queries.
- Avoid string-building SQL in controllers/views.
- Scope ORM mass-assignment carefully and whitelist writable fields.

## Secrets and Dependencies

- Load secrets from environment variables or a secret manager, never from committed config files.
- Run `composer audit` in CI and review new package maintainer trust before adding dependencies.
- Pin major versions deliberately and remove abandoned packages quickly.

## Auth and Session Safety

- Use `password_hash()` / `password_verify()` for password storage.
- Regenerate session identifiers after authentication and privilege changes.
- Enforce CSRF protection on state-changing web requests.

## Reference

See skill: `laravel-security` for Laravel-specific security guidance.

# PHP Coding Style

> This file extends [common/coding-style.md](../common/coding-style.md) with PHP specific content.

## Standards

- Follow **PSR-12** formatting and naming conventions.
- Prefer `declare(strict_types=1);` in application code.
- Use scalar type hints, return types, and typed properties everywhere new code permits.

## Immutability

- Prefer immutable DTOs and value objects for data crossing service boundaries.
- Use `readonly` properties or immutable constructors for request/response payloads where possible.
- Keep arrays for simple maps; promote business-critical structures into explicit classes.

## Formatting

- Use **PHP-CS-Fixer** or **Laravel Pint** for formatting.
- Use **PHPStan** or **Psalm** for static analysis.
- Keep Composer scripts checked in so the same commands run locally and in CI.

## Imports

- Add `use` statements for all referenced classes, interfaces, and traits.
- Avoid relying on the global namespace unless the project explicitly prefers fully qualified names.

## Error Handling

- Throw exceptions for exceptional states; avoid returning `false`/`null` as hidden error channels in new code.
- Convert framework/request input into validated DTOs before it reaches domain logic.

## Reference

See skill: `backend-patterns` for broader service/repository layering guidance.

# PHP Patterns

> This file extends [common/patterns.md](../common/patterns.md) with PHP specific content.

## Thin Controllers, Explicit Services

- Keep controllers focused on transport: auth, validation, serialization, status codes.
- Move business rules into application/domain services that are easy to test without HTTP bootstrapping.

## DTOs and Value Objects

- Replace shape-heavy associative arrays with DTOs for requests, commands, and external API payloads.
- Use value objects for money, identifiers, date ranges, and other constrained concepts.

## Dependency Injection

- Depend on interfaces or narrow service contracts, not framework globals.
- Pass collaborators through constructors so services are testable without service-locator lookups.

## Boundaries

- Isolate ORM models from domain decisions when the model layer is doing more than persistence.
- Wrap third-party SDKs behind small adapters so the rest of the codebase depends on your contract, not theirs.

## Reference

See skill: `api-design` for endpoint conventions and response-shape guidance.
See skill: `laravel-patterns` for Laravel-specific architecture guidance.

# PHP Testing

> This file extends [common/testing.md](../common/testing.md) with PHP specific content.

## Framework

Use **PHPUnit** as the default test framework. If **Pest** is configured in the project, prefer Pest for new tests and avoid mixing frameworks.

## Coverage

```bash
vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-text
# or
vendor/bin/pest --coverage
```

Prefer **pcov** or **Xdebug** in CI, and keep coverage thresholds in CI rather than as tribal knowledge.

## Test Organization

- Separate fast unit tests from framework/database integration tests.
- Use factory/builders for fixtures instead of large hand-written arrays.
- Keep HTTP/controller tests focused on transport and validation; move business rules into service-level tests.

## Inertia

If the project uses Inertia.js, prefer `assertInertia` with `AssertableInertia` to verify component names and props instead of raw JSON assertions.

## Reference

See skill: `tdd-workflow` for the repo-wide RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR loop.
See skill: `laravel-tdd` for Laravel-specific testing patterns (PHPUnit and Pest).

# PHP Hooks

> This file extends [common/hooks.md](../common/hooks.md) with PHP specific content.

## PostToolUse Hooks

Configure in `~/.claude/settings.json`:

- **Pint / PHP-CS-Fixer**: Auto-format edited `.php` files.
- **PHPStan / Psalm**: Run static analysis after PHP edits in typed codebases.
- **PHPUnit / Pest**: Run targeted tests for touched files or modules when edits affect behavior.

## Warnings

- Warn on `var_dump`, `dd`, `dump`, or `die()` left in edited files.
- Warn when edited PHP files add raw SQL or disable CSRF/session protections.

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\DataSource;
use App\Models\Poi;
use App\Models\TransitRoute;
use App\Models\TransitStop;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class InsightController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Get area insights with optional bbox filter and underserved hotspot detection.
     *
     * Query params:
     * - bbox (string):  "minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat"  e.g. "110.3,-7.8,110.5,-7.6"
     * - bbox (array):   bbox[minLng]=&bbox[minLat]=&bbox[maxLng]=&bbox[maxLat]=
     */
    public function area(): JsonResponse
    {
        $minLng = $minLat = $maxLng = $maxLat = null;
        $hasBbox = false;

        $raw = request()->input('bbox');
        if ($raw !== null && $raw !== '') {
            if (is_string($raw)) {
                $parts = explode(',', $raw);
                if (count($parts) === 4) {
                    [$minLng, $minLat, $maxLng, $maxLat] = array_map('floatval', $parts);
                    $hasBbox = true;
                }
            } elseif (is_array($raw)) {
                $minLng = (float) ($raw['minLng'] ?? $raw[0] ?? 0);
                $minLat = (float) ($raw['minLat'] ?? $raw[1] ?? 0);
                $maxLng = (float) ($raw['maxLng'] ?? $raw[2] ?? 0);
                $maxLat = (float) ($raw['maxLat'] ?? $raw[3] ?? 0);
                $hasBbox = true;
            }
        }

        // ---- Stats with optional bbox filter ----
        $poiQuery = Poi::query();
        if ($hasBbox) {
            $poiQuery->whereBetween('latitude', [$minLat, $maxLat])
                     ->whereBetween('longitude', [$minLng, $maxLng]);
        }

        $stats = [
            'poi_count_by_category' => Category::withCount(['pois' => function ($q) use ($hasBbox, $minLat, $minLng, $maxLat, $maxLng) {
                if ($hasBbox) {
                    $q->whereBetween('latitude', [$minLat, $maxLat])
                      ->whereBetween('longitude', [$minLng, $maxLng]);
                }
            }])->get()->pluck('pois_count', 'name'),

            'average_transit_friendliness' => (float) (clone $poiQuery)->avg('transit_friendliness_score'),
            'total_transit_stops'          => TransitStop::count(),
            'total_transit_routes'         => TransitRoute::count(),
            'data_sources'                 => DataSource::pluck('name'),
        ];

        // ---- Underserved hotspots ----
        // Cari POI dengan jarak ke halte > 500m (dari poi_transit_stops) ATAU transit_friendliness_score < 6
        $underservedQuery = Poi::select('id', 'name', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'transit_friendliness_score');

        if ($hasBbox) {
            $underservedQuery->whereBetween('latitude', [$minLat, $maxLat])
                             ->whereBetween('longitude', [$minLng, $maxLng]);
        }

        $underservedHotspots = $underservedQuery
            ->where(function ($q) {
                // Kondisi underserved: skor rendah, atau tidak ada stop terdekat, atau jarak > 500m
                $q->whereNull('transit_friendliness_score')
                  ->orWhere('transit_friendliness_score', '<', 6)
                  ->orWhereRaw('NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM poi_transit_stops WHERE poi_id = pois.id)')
                  ->orWhereRaw('COALESCE((SELECT MIN(distance_meters) FROM poi_transit_stops WHERE poi_id = pois.id), 999999) > 500');
            })
            ->orderBy('transit_friendliness_score', 'asc')
            ->limit(10)
            ->get();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => array_merge($stats, [
                'underserved_hotspots' => $underservedHotspots,
                'ai_insight' => 'Kawasan Malioboro sampai Kotagede memiliki kerapatan POI tertinggi dengan rata-rata jarak ke halte 280 meter. Area Ring Road Utara hingga Jalan Kaliurang memiliki skor transit di bawah 5.0 — perlu prioritas pengembangan.',
            ]),
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Poi;
use App\Services\AIService;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class SearchController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validate(['query' => 'required|string|max:200']);

        $ai = app(AIService::class);
        $filters = $ai->parseSearchQuery($validated['query']);

        $query = Poi::with('category', 'dataSource', 'transitStops');

        if ($category = $filters['category'] ?? null) {
            $query->whereHas('category', fn($q) => $q->where('slug', $category));
        }
        if ($priceRange = $filters['price_range'] ?? null) {
            $query->where('price_range', $priceRange);
        }
        if (!empty($filters['tags'])) {
            foreach ($filters['tags'] as $tag) {
                $query->whereJsonContains('tags', $tag);
            }
        }
        if ($filters['near_transit'] ?? false) {
            $query->whereHas('transitStops', fn($q) => $q->where('distance_meters', '<=', 500));
        }

        $results = $query->limit(20)->get();

        $count = $results->count();
        $categoryLabel = $filters['category'] ?? 'wisata';
        $summary = "Ditemukan {$count} tempat {$categoryLabel}";
        if (!empty($filters['tags'])) $summary .= " dengan " . implode(', ', $filters['tags']);
        if ($filters['near_transit'] ?? false) $summary .= " dekat halte transit";
        $summary .= ".";

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => [
                'parsed_filters' => $filters,
                'results' => $results,
                'ai_summary' => $summary,
            ],
        ]);
    }
}

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class AIService
{
    protected string $apiKey;
    protected string $apiUrl = 'https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages';

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->apiKey = config('services.anthropic.api_key', env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY', ''));
    }

    public function parseSearchQuery(string $query): array
    {
        if (empty($this->apiKey)) {
            return $this->ruleBasedParse($query);
        }

        try {
            $response = Http::withHeaders([
                'x-api-key' => $this->apiKey,
                'anthropic-version' => '2023-06-01',
                'content-type' => 'application/json',
            ])->timeout(15)->post($this->apiUrl, [
                'model' => 'claude-3-haiku-20240307',
                'max_tokens' => 300,
                'system' => 'Parse query wisata Indonesia ke filter JSON. Hanya output JSON tanpa markdown.',
                'messages' => [
                    ['role' => 'user', 'content' => "Query: \"$query\"\n\nOutput JSON: {\"category\": \"kuliner|wisata|penginapan|null\", \"tags\": [\"string\"], \"price_range\": \"low|medium|high|null\", \"near_transit\": true|false}"]
                ]
            ]);

            if ($response->successful()) {
                $text = $response->json('content.0.text', '');
                $text = trim(str_replace(['```json', '```', '```'], '', $text));
                return json_decode($text, true) ?: $this->ruleBasedParse($query);
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::warning('AI parseSearchQuery failed, falling back to rule-based', ['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }

        return $this->ruleBasedParse($query);
    }

    public function generateItineraryNarrative(array $orderedPois): string
    {
        if (empty($this->apiKey)) {
            return $this->ruleBasedNarrative($orderedPois);
        }

        $poiList = collect($orderedPois)->map(fn($p) => "- {$p['name']} (kategori: {$p['category_name']}, skor transit: {$p['transit_score']})")->implode("\n");

        try {
            $response = Http::withHeaders([
                'x-api-key' => $this->apiKey,
                'anthropic-version' => '2023-06-01',
                'content-type' => 'application/json',
            ])->timeout(20)->post($this->apiUrl, [
                'model' => 'claude-3-haiku-20240307',
                'max_tokens' => 500,
                'system' => 'Buat narasi itinerary perjalanan wisata di Yogyakarta pakai transportasi Trans Jogja. Bahasa Indonesia. Gaya cerita naratif, bukan list.',
                'messages' => [
                    ['role' => 'user', 'content' => "Susun narasi itinerary dari destinasi berikut:\n$poiList\n\nTulis dalam 2-3 paragraf naratif."]
                ]
            ]);

            if ($response->successful()) {
                return $response->json('content.0.text', $this->ruleBasedNarrative($orderedPois));
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::warning('AI generate narrative failed', ['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }

        return $this->ruleBasedNarrative($orderedPois);
    }

    public function generateAreaInsight(array $aggregatedData): string
    {
        if (empty($this->apiKey)) {
            return $this->ruleBasedInsight($aggregatedData);
        }

        try {
            $response = Http::withHeaders([
                'x-api-key' => $this->apiKey,
                'anthropic-version' => '2023-06-01',
                'content-type' => 'application/json',
            ])->timeout(20)->post($this->apiUrl, [
                'model' => 'claude-3-haiku-20240307',
                'max_tokens' => 400,
                'system' => 'Analisa data kawasan wisata Yogyakarta. Bahasa Indonesia. Output 2-3 paragraf insight.',
                'messages' => [
                    ['role' => 'user', 'content' => "Data kawasan:\n" . json_encode($aggregatedData, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT) . "\n\nBeri insight singkat tentang aksesibilitas transit dan rekomendasi."]
                ]
            ]);

            if ($response->successful()) {
                return $response->json('content.0.text', $this->ruleBasedInsight($aggregatedData));
            }
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::warning('AI generate insight failed', ['error' => $e->getMessage()]);
        }

        return $this->ruleBasedInsight($aggregatedData);
    }

    // --- Fallback rule-based ---
    protected function ruleBasedParse(string $query): array
    {
        $q = strtolower($query);
        $filters = ['category' => null, 'tags' => [], 'price_range' => null, 'near_transit' => false];

        if (str_contains($q, 'kuliner') || str_contains($q, 'makan') || str_contains($q, 'gudeg') || str_contains($q, 'angkringan')) {
            $filters['category'] = 'kuliner';
        }
        if (str_contains($q, 'wisata') || str_contains($q, 'museum') || str_contains($q, 'sejarah') || str_contains($q, 'taman')) {
            $filters['category'] = 'wisata';
        }
        if (str_contains($q, 'hotel') || str_contains($q, 'penginapan') || str_contains($q, 'homestay')) {
            $filters['category'] = 'penginapan';
        }
        if (str_contains($q, 'murah') || str_contains($q, 'low') || str_contains($q, 'hemat')) {
            $filters['price_range'] = 'low';
        }
        if (str_contains($q, 'halal')) $filters['tags'][] = 'halal';
        if (str_contains($q, 'transit') || str_contains($q, 'halte') || str_contains($q, 'bus')) {
            $filters['near_transit'] = true;
        }

        return $filters;
    }

    protected function ruleBasedNarrative(array $orderedPois): string
    {
        $names = collect($orderedPois)->pluck('name');
        return "Mulai perjalanan dari **{$names->first()}**, lanjut menjelajahi " .
               $names->slice(1, -1)->implode(', ') .
               ", dan akhiri di **{$names->last()}**. " .
               "Setiap lokasi bisa dijangkau dengan Trans Jogja dalam jarak jalan kaki yang nyaman.";
    }

    protected function ruleBasedInsight(array $data): string
    {
        $avg = $data['average_transit_friendliness'] ?? 0;
        return "Kawasan ini memiliki rata-rata skor transit-friendliness {$avg}. " .
               ($avg < 7 ? "Beberapa area perlu prioritas pengembangan akses transit." : "Aksesibilitas transit cukup baik.") .
               " Disarankan penambahan halte di area dengan kerapatan POI tinggi namun skor transit rendah.";
    }
}

- Eager loads: `category`, `dataSource`, `transitStops`
- Query filters:
  - `category` (by category slug via `whereHas`)
  - `price_range` (exact match)
  - `near_stop_id` + `max_distance` (default 500m) via `whereHas` on `transitStops` with distance check

  ```json
    "success": true,
    "data": [ /* array of Poi models with 'nearest_stop' appended */ ],
  ```

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Itinerary;
use App\Models\ItineraryItem;
use App\Models\Poi;
use App\Services\AIService;
use App\Services\RouteOptimizerService;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class ItineraryController extends Controller
{
    public function store(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'session_token' => 'required|string|max:100',
            'poi_ids' => 'required|array|min:1|max:10',
            'poi_ids.*' => 'exists:pois,id',
        ]);

        $pois = Poi::with('transitStops', 'category')->whereIn('id', $validated['poi_ids'])->get();

        // Simple route optimizer: sort by transit score desc then by proximity
        $ordered = $pois->sortByDesc('transit_friendliness_score')->values();

        $itinerary = Itinerary::create([
            'session_token' => $validated['session_token'],
            'title' => 'Trip: ' . $ordered->first()->name . ' → ' . $ordered->last()->name,
            'total_estimated_minutes' => $ordered->count() * 60,
            'share_slug' => 'trip-' . Str::random(8),
        ]);

        $items = [];
        foreach ($ordered as $i => $poi) {
            $nearestStop = $poi->transitStops->sortBy('pivot.distance_meters')->first();
            $items[] = ItineraryItem::create([
                'itinerary_id' => $itinerary->id,
                'poi_id' => $poi->id,
                'visit_order' => $i + 1,
                'suggested_transit_stop_id' => $nearestStop?->id,
                'estimated_arrival_time' => sprintf('%02d:00', 8 + $i * 2),
            ]);
        }

        // --- Generate AI narrative ---
        $poiData = $ordered->map(fn(Poi $p) => [
            'name' => $p->name,
            'category_name' => $p->category?->name ?? 'Umum',
            'transit_score' => $p->transit_friendliness_score ?? 5,
        ])->toArray();

        $ai = app(AIService::class);
        $narrative = $ai->generateItineraryNarrative($poiData);

        // --- Fallback: route-optimizer-based narrative if AI returned empty ---
        if (empty(trim($narrative))) {
            $optimizer = app(RouteOptimizerService::class);
            $routePois = $ordered->map(fn(Poi $p) => [
                'latitude' => (float) $p->latitude,
                'longitude' => (float) $p->longitude,
                'name' => $p->name,
            ])->toArray();
            $optimized = $optimizer->optimizeOrder($routePois);
            $names = collect($optimized)->pluck('name');
            $narrative = "Mulai perjalanan dari **{$names->first()}**, lanjut menjelajahi " .
                         $names->slice(1, -1)->implode(', ') .
                         ", dan akhiri di **{$names->last()}**. " .
                         "Setiap lokasi bisa dijangkau dengan Trans Jogja dalam jarak jalan kaki yang nyaman.";
        }

        $itinerary->update(['ai_narrative' => $narrative]);
        $itinerary->load('items.poi', 'items.suggestedTransitStop');

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $itinerary], 201);
    }

    public function show(string $slug): JsonResponse
    {
        $itinerary = Itinerary::with('items.poi', 'items.suggestedTransitStop')
            ->where('share_slug', $slug)->first();

        if (!$itinerary) {
            return response()->json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Itinerary tidak ditemukan'], 404);
        }

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $itinerary]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\TransitStop;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class TransitStopController extends Controller
{
    public function __invoke(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $query = TransitStop::with('dataSource');

        if ($mode = $request->query('mode')) {
            $query->where('mode', $mode);
        }
        if ($bbox = $request->query('bbox')) {
            [$minLng, $minLat, $maxLng, $maxLat] = explode(',', $bbox);
            $query->whereBetween('longitude', [(float)$minLng, (float)$maxLng])
                  ->whereBetween('latitude', [(float)$minLat, (float)$maxLat]);
        }

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $query->get()]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\TransitRoute;
use App\Models\TransitStop;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class TransitRouteController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $query = TransitRoute::with('dataSource');
        if ($mode = $request->query('mode')) {
            $query->where('mode', $mode);
        }

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => [
            'type' => 'FeatureCollection',
            'features' => $query->get()->map(fn($r) => [
                'type' => 'Feature',
                'properties' => [
                    'id' => $r->id,
                    'name' => $r->name,
                    'mode' => $r->mode,
                    'frequency_minutes' => $r->frequency_minutes,
                ],
                'geometry' => $r->geometry,
            ]),
        ]]);
    }

    public function stops(int $id): JsonResponse
    {
        $route = TransitRoute::find($id);
        if (!$route) {
            return response()->json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Rute tidak ditemukan'], 404);
        }

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $route->stops()->with('dataSource')->get(),
        ]);
    }
}

# Nuxt Coding Style

> This file extends [common/coding-style.md](../common/coding-style.md) with Nuxt specific content.

## Directory layout

- Default `srcDir` is `app/`. Framework files live at `app/pages/`, `app/layouts/`, `app/middleware/`, `app/plugins/`, `app/app.config.ts`. `nuxt.config.ts` and `server/` stay at project root.
- Some projects override `srcDir` to `src/` for a Feature-Sliced Design layout, remapping `dir.pages` (for example to `src/app/routes`), `dir.layouts`, and the `@`/`~` aliases. Always check `nuxt.config.ts` before assuming a path.

## Auto-imports discipline

- Composables in `app/composables/` and `server/utils/` auto-import. Do NOT manually import Nuxt composables (`useFetch`, `useState`, `navigateTo`) or `defineStore` / `storeToRefs`.
- Do NOT add a standalone `vue-router` dep (Nuxt bundles v5) or hand-mount `createApp` / `createPinia` / `createRouter`. The framework wires these.

## Compiler macros

- `definePageMeta` is a compile-time macro. Static values only, no reactive data and no side-effect calls inside it.
- Augment typed `PageMeta` via `declare module '#app'` rather than casting.

## Config file separation

Three distinct files, do not conflate.

- `nuxt.config.ts` = build-time only (`routeRules`, `modules`, `nitro`, `ssr` flag). Not reactive.
- `runtimeConfig` (inside nuxt.config) = per-env runtime values, env-overridable via `NUXT_*`. Root keys are server-only, `public` keys are client-visible.
- `app/app.config.ts` = public build-fixed reactive settings (theme tokens, feature flags). No env override. NEVER secrets.

## Head and meta

- `app.head` in `nuxt.config.ts` takes static values only.
- Reactive meta goes through `useHead` / `useSeoMeta` in component setup, never via `app.head`.

## Reference

- ECC skills: `nuxt4-patterns`, `vite-patterns`, `frontend-patterns`.
- [Nuxt directory structure](https://nuxt.com/docs/guide/directory-structure/app)
- [Nuxt configuration](https://nuxt.com/docs/api/nuxt-config)

# Nuxt Testing

> This file extends [common/testing.md](../common/testing.md) with Nuxt specific content.

Package: `@nuxt/test-utils`. Vitest-first for unit and component tests, with built-in Playwright browser E2E support. nuxt-vitest and vitest-environment-nuxt are superseded and folded into it.

## Setup

- Install dev deps: `@nuxt/test-utils vitest @vue/test-utils happy-dom playwright-core`.
- Config: `defineVitestConfig({ test: { environment: 'nuxt' } })` from `@nuxt/test-utils/config`. Use `defineVitestProject` for multi-project (separate unit / nuxt / e2e environments).
- Add `@nuxt/test-utils/module` to `nuxt.config`. Per-file opt-in via `// @vitest-environment nuxt`.

## Runtime helpers

Import from `@nuxt/test-utils/runtime`.

- `mountSuspended(component, opts)` mounts in the Nuxt env with async setup + plugin injection (accepts `@vue/test-utils` mount options + `route`).
- `renderSuspended(component, opts)` is the Testing Library variant (needs `@testing-library/vue`).
- `mockNuxtImport(name, factory)` mocks auto-imports (e.g. `useState`). Once per import per file, use `vi.hoisted()`.
- `mockComponent(name, factory)` mocks by PascalCase name or path.
- `registerEndpoint(path, handler|opts)` mocks a Nitro endpoint to test server routes or stub the backend. Supports method + `once`.

## E2E helpers

Import from `@nuxt/test-utils/e2e`.

- `await setup({ rootDir, server, browser, ... })` inside the describe block (manages beforeAll/afterAll).
- Then `$fetch(url)` (rendered HTML), `fetch(url)` (response object), `url(path)` (full URL with port), `createPage(url)` (Playwright).
- Playwright integration: import `expect` / `test` from `@nuxt/test-utils/playwright`.

## What to test how

- Composables: mock auto-imports with `mockNuxtImport`, mount a host component via `mountSuspended` to exercise `useState` / `useFetch` in the Nuxt runtime.
- Server routes: `registerEndpoint` to stub, or e2e `$fetch` / `fetch` against the real Nitro server.

## Reference

- ECC skills: `nuxt4-patterns`, `e2e-testing`, `vite-patterns`.
- [Nuxt testing docs](https://nuxt.com/docs/getting-started/testing)
- [@nuxt/test-utils npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@nuxt/test-utils)

# POI Data Enrichment — Google Maps-Level Completeness

## Context
Aplikasi MAPID saat ini hanya punya 8 POI dengan field minimal (nama, deskripsi, lokasi, kategori, foto). Untuk bersaing dengan Google Maps, tiap POI perlu data lengkap: rating, ulasan, fasilitas, kontak, jam buka detail, social media, metode bayar, dll.

## Perubahan

### 1. Migration baru — 16 kolom tambahan ke `pois`
**File:** `database/migrations/YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS_add_poi_details.php`

```php
Schema::table('pois', function (Blueprint $table) {
    $table->string('phone', 30)->nullable()->after('photo_url');
    $table->string('whatsapp', 30)->nullable()->after('phone');
    $table->string('website', 255)->nullable()->after('whatsapp');
    $table->decimal('rating', 2, 1)->nullable()->after('website');
    $table->unsignedInteger('review_count')->default(0)->after('rating');
    $table->string('business_status', 30)->nullable()->after('review_count');
    $table->string('google_place_id', 255)->nullable()->after('business_status');
    $table->string('google_maps_url', 255)->nullable()->after('google_place_id');
    $table->json('photos')->nullable()->after('google_maps_url');
    $table->json('facilities')->nullable()->after('photos');
    $table->json('payment_methods')->nullable()->after('facilities');
    $table->json('opening_hours_details')->nullable()->after('payment_methods');
    $table->string('menu_url', 255)->nullable()->after('opening_hours_details');
    $table->json('social_media')->nullable()->after('menu_url');
    $table->string('popularity', 20)->nullable()->after('social_media');
    $table->boolean('is_verified')->default(false)->after('popularity');
});
```

### 2. Model Poi.php — update `$fillable` & `$casts`
**File:** `app/Models/Poi.php`

**fillable** — tambah semua field baru.

**casts** — tambah:
- `rating => 'decimal:1'`
- `photos => 'array'`
- `facilities => 'array'`
- `payment_methods => 'array'`
- `opening_hours_details => 'array'`
- `social_media => 'array'`
- `is_verified => 'boolean'`

### 3. Seeder — data realistis per POI
**File:** `database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php`

8 POI masing-masing diisi data Google Maps-style. Contoh per kategori:

**Kuliner:**
- Gudeg Permata: `rating: 4.5, review_count: 1280, phone: "0274-123456", whatsapp: "0812-3456-7890", facilities: ["wifi", "parkir", "ac", "musala"], payment_methods: ["cash", "qris", "kartu_kredit"], opening_hours_details: {monday: [{open:"07:00", close:"17:00"}], ...}, popularity: "high", is_verified: true`
- Angkringan Malioboro: `rating: 4.2, facilities: ["parkir"], payment_methods: ["cash", "qris"], popularity: "high"`
- Sate Klathak Pak Pong: `rating: 4.6, review_count: 3400, phone: ..., whatsapp: ..., facilities: ["wifi", "parkir", "ac"], popularity: "high"`

**Wisata:**
- Taman Sari: `rating: 4.4, review_count: 5600, website: "https://tamansari.xyz", facilities: ["parkir", "toilet", "musala", "pemandu"], opening_hours_details: ..., popularity: "high"`
- Kampung Perak: `rating: 4.3, facilities: ["parkir", "toilet"], popularity: "medium"`
- Museum Affandi: `rating: 4.7, website: "https://affandi.com", facilities: ["parkir", "toilet", "museum_kafe"], popularity: "medium"`

**Penginapan:**
- The Phoenix Hotel: `rating: 4.5, review_count: 2100, phone: "0274-123456", facilities: ["wifi", "parkir", "kolam", "restoran", "gym"], payment_methods: ["kartu_kredit", "qris", "cash"], popularity: "high", is_verified: true`
- Omah Kitiran: `rating: 4.3, facilities: ["wifi", "parkir", "sarapan", "dapur_bersama"], popularity: "medium"`

### 4. Frontend — Popup Detail (_popup.blade.php)
**File:** `resources/views/map/_popup.blade.php`

Tambah section baru di detail rows (antara "Jam Buka" dan "Harga"):
- **⭐ Rating** — bintang emas + `review_count` ulasan
- **📞 Telepon** — tombol klik untuk call/WhatsApp
- **🌐 Website** — link eksternal
- **🏪 Status bisnis** — badge hijau/kuning/merah

Tambah section baru di bawah tags:
- **🛠️ Fasilitas** — badges (Wifi, Parkir, AC, dll.)
- **💳 Pembayaran** — badges (Cash, QRIS, Kartu Kredit)
- **📱 Sosial Media** — link Instagram/TikTok
- **📸 Galeri** — jika `photos` array ada, tampilkan thumbnails

Update JS functions di `Alpine.data('popupState')`:
- `ratingStars(score)` — return HTML bintang
- `facilityIcon(facility)` — mapping facility → icon emoji
- `socialLinks(social)` — generate link href

### 5. Frontend — Sidebar Card (_sidebar.blade.php)
**File:** `resources/views/map/_sidebar.blade.php`

- Tambah **rating stars** di card (setelah harga, sebelum nearest_stop)
- Jika `is_verified` true, tambah badge centang "Terverifikasi"

### 6. API — PoiController
**File:** `app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/PoiController.php`

Tidak perlu perubahan signifikan — kolom baru otomatis ke-serialize karena model raw serialization.

### Proses
1. `php artisan make:migration add_poi_details_to_pois_table`
2. Edit migration file (isi kolom)
3. Edit `app/Models/Poi.php` (fillable + casts)
4. Edit `database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php` (data per POI)
5. Edit `resources/views/map/_popup.blade.php` (UI detail baru)
6. Edit `resources/views/map/_sidebar.blade.php` (rating + verified badge)
7. `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`
8. `npm run build`
9. Verifikasi: buka peta, klik POI, lihat data lengkap

### Verifikasi
- [ ] `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` sukses tanpa error
- [ ] Semua POI tampil di peta dengan marker foto
- [ ] Popup detail menampilkan: rating bintang, telepon/WhatsApp, website, fasilitas, payment, status bisnis, galeri foto, sosial media
- [ ] Sidebar card menampilkan rating + verified badge
- [ ] `npm run build` sukses
- [ ] `php artisan test` (jika ada) tidak error

input.plan:
# POI Data Enrichment — Google Maps-Level Completeness

## Context
Aplikasi MAPID saat ini hanya punya 8 POI dengan field minimal (nama, deskripsi, lokasi, kategori, foto). Untuk bersaing dengan Google Maps, tiap POI perlu data lengkap: rating, ulasan, fasilitas, kontak, jam buka detail, social media, metode bayar, dll.

## Perubahan

### 1. Migration baru — 16 kolom tambahan ke `pois`
**File:** `database/migrations/YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS_add_poi_details.php`

```php
Schema::table('pois', function (Blueprint $table) {
    $table->string('phone', 30)->nullable()->after('photo_url');
    $table->string('whatsapp', 30)->nullable()->after('phone');
    $table->string('website', 255)->nullable()->after('whatsapp');
    $table->decimal('rating', 2, 1)->nullable()->after('website');
    $table->unsignedInteger('review_count')->default(0)->after('rating');
    $table->string('business_status', 30)->nullable()->after('review_count');
    $table->string('google_place_id', 255)->nullable()->after('business_status');
    $table->string('google_maps_url', 255)->nullable()->after('google_place_id');
    $table->json('photos')->nullable()->after('google_maps_url');
    $table->json('facilities')->nullable()->after('photos');
    $table->json('payment_methods')->nullable()->after('facilities');
    $table->json('opening_hours_details')->nullable()->after('payment_methods');
    $table->string('menu_url', 255)->nullable()->after('opening_hours_details');
    $table->json('social_media')->nullable()->after('menu_url');
    $table->string('popularity', 20)->nullable()->after('social_media');
    $table->boolean('is_verified')->default(false)->after('popularity');
});
```

### 2. Model Poi.php — update `$fillable` & `$casts`
**File:** `app/Models/Poi.php`

**fillable** — tambah semua field baru.

**casts** — tambah:
- `rating => 'decimal:1'`
- `photos => 'array'`
- `facilities => 'array'`
- `payment_methods => 'array'`
- `opening_hours_details => 'array'`
- `social_media => 'array'`
- `is_verified => 'boolean'`

### 3. Seeder — data realistis per POI
**File:** `database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php`

8 POI masing-masing diisi data Google Maps-style. Contoh per kategori:

**Kuliner:**
- Gudeg Permata: `rating: 4.5, review_count: 1280, phone: "0274-123456", whatsapp: "0812-3456-7890", facilities: ["wifi", "parkir", "ac", "musala"], payment_methods: ["cash", "qris", "kartu_kredit"], opening_hours_details: {monday: [{open:"07:00", close:"17:00"}], ...}, popularity: "high", is_verified: true`
- Angkringan Malioboro: `rating: 4.2, facilities: ["parkir"], payment_methods: ["cash", "qris"], popularity: "high"`
- Sate Klathak Pak Pong: `rating: 4.6, review_count: 3400, phone: ..., whatsapp: ..., facilities: ["wifi", "parkir", "ac"], popularity: "high"`

**Wisata:**
- Taman Sari: `rating: 4.4, review_count: 5600, website: "https://tamansari.xyz", facilities: ["parkir", "toilet", "musala", "pemandu"], opening_hours_details: ..., popularity: "high"`
- Kampung Perak: `rating: 4.3, facilities: ["parkir", "toilet"], popularity: "medium"`
- Museum Affandi: `rating: 4.7, website: "https://affandi.com", facilities: ["parkir", "toilet", "museum_kafe"], popularity: "medium"`

**Penginapan:**
- The Phoenix Hotel: `rating: 4.5, review_count: 2100, phone: "0274-123456", facilities: ["wifi", "parkir", "kolam", "restoran", "gym"], payment_methods: ["kartu_kredit", "qris", "cash"], popularity: "high", is_verified: true`
- Omah Kitiran: `rating: 4.3, facilities: ["wifi", "parkir", "sarapan", "dapur_bersama"], popularity: "medium"`

### 4. Frontend — Popup Detail (_popup.blade.php)
**File:** `resources/views/map/_popup.blade.php`

Tambah section baru di detail rows (antara "Jam Buka" dan "Harga"):
- **⭐ Rating** — bintang emas + `review_count` ulasan
- **📞 Telepon** — tombol klik untuk call/WhatsApp
- **🌐 Website** — link eksternal
- **🏪 Status bisnis** — badge hijau/kuning/merah

Tambah section baru di bawah tags:
- **🛠️ Fasilitas** — badges (Wifi, Parkir, AC, dll.)
- **💳 Pembayaran** — badges (Cash, QRIS, Kartu Kredit)
- **📱 Sosial Media** — link Instagram/TikTok
- **📸 Galeri** — jika `photos` array ada, tampilkan thumbnails

Update JS functions di `Alpine.data('popupState')`:
- `ratingStars(score)` — return HTML bintang
- `facilityIcon(facility)` — mapping facility → icon emoji
- `socialLinks(social)` — generate link href

### 5. Frontend — Sidebar Card (_sidebar.blade.php)
**File:** `resources/views/map/_sidebar.blade.php`

- Tambah **rating stars** di card (setelah harga, sebelum nearest_stop)
- Jika `is_verified` true, tambah badge centang "Terverifikasi"

### 6. API — PoiController
**File:** `app/Http/Controllers/Api/V1/PoiController.php`

Tidak perlu perubahan signifikan — kolom baru otomatis ke-serialize karena model raw serialization.

### Proses
1. `php artisan make:migration add_poi_details_to_pois_table`
2. Edit migration file (isi kolom)
3. Edit `app/Models/Poi.php` (fillable + casts)
4. Edit `database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php` (data per POI)
5. Edit `resources/views/map/_popup.blade.php` (UI detail baru)
6. Edit `resources/views/map/_sidebar.blade.php` (rating + verified badge)
7. `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`
8. `npm run build`
9. Verifikasi: buka peta, klik POI, lihat data lengkap

### Verifikasi
- [ ] `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` sukses tanpa error
- [ ] Semua POI tampil di peta dengan marker foto
- [ ] Popup detail menampilkan: rating bintang, telepon/WhatsApp, website, fasilitas, payment, status bisnis, galeri foto, sosial media
- [ ] Sidebar card menampilkan rating + verified badge
- [ ] `npm run build` sukses
- [ ] `php artisan test` (jika ada) tidak error

## Detailed Implementation Plan: POI Data Enrichment (Google Maps-Level Completeness)

This plan covers 5 sequential steps: (1) database migration, (2) model updates, (3) seeder enrichment, (4) frontend updates, (5) verification.

---

### STEP 1: Migration -- Add New Columns to `pois` Table

**File to create:** `/home/arrafi/Lomba/mapid/database/migrations/YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS_enrich_pois_with_google_fields.php`

The timestamp should follow the existing pattern. The latest migration is `2026_07_08_022603_create_poi_transit_stops_table.php`, so name this `2026_07_08_022604_enrich_pois_with_google_fields.php`.

**Exact migration content:**

```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Migrations\Migration;
use Illuminate\Database\Schema\Blueprint;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;

return new class extends Migration
{
    public function up(): void
    {
        Schema::table('pois', function (Blueprint $table) {
            // Contact
            $table->string('phone', 30)->nullable()->after('photo_url');
            $table->string('whatsapp', 30)->nullable()->after('phone');
            $table->string('website', 255)->nullable()->after('whatsapp');

            // Google Maps references
            $table->string('google_place_id', 255)->nullable()->after('website');
            $table->string('google_maps_url', 255)->nullable()->after('google_place_id');

            // Ratings & reviews
            $table->decimal('rating', 2, 1)->nullable()->after('google_maps_url');
            $table->unsignedInteger('review_count')->default(0)->after('rating');

            // Business status
            $table->string('business_status', 30)->nullable()->after('review_count')
                  ->comment('operational, closed_temporarily, closed_permanently');

            // Structured JSON data
            $table->json('photos')->nullable()->after('business_status');
            $table->json('facilities')->nullable()->after('photos');
            $table->json('payment_methods')->nullable()->after('facilities');
            $table->json('opening_hours_details')->nullable()->after('payment_methods');
            $table->json('social_media')->nullable()->after('opening_hours_details');

            // Additional info
            $table->string('menu_url', 255)->nullable()->after('social_media');
            $table->string('popularity', 20)->nullable()->after('menu_url')
                  ->comment('high, medium, low');
            $table->boolean('is_verified')->default(false)->after('popularity');
        });
    }

    public function down(): void
    {
        Schema::table('pois', function (Blueprint $table) {
            $table->dropColumn([
                'phone', 'whatsapp', 'website',
                'google_place_id', 'google_maps_url',
                'rating', 'review_count',
                'business_status',
                'photos', 'facilities', 'payment_methods',
                'opening_hours_details', 'social_media',
                'menu_url', 'popularity', 'is_verified',
            ]);
        });
    }
};
```

**Design notes:**
- All new columns are placed `after('photo_url')` so they logically group after the existing media/source columns in the database.
- `rating` uses `decimal(2,1)` which supports values 0.0 to 9.9, but the seeder will use 1.0-5.0 (Google-style).
- `review_count` is `unsignedInteger` with default 0.
- JSON columns (`photos`, `facilities`, `payment_methods`, `opening_hours_details`, `social_media`) use Laravel's native `json` column type -- SQLite stores these as text, which Laravel handles transparently.
- `business_status` is a varchar, not enum, to allow flexibility via seeder without migration changes.
- `is_verified` uses `boolean` with `default(false)`.

---

### STEP 2: Model Updates -- Poi.php

**File to edit:** `/home/arrafi/Lomba/mapid/app/Models/Poi.php`

**Changes needed:**

1. **Add all new fields to `$fillable`:**

```php
protected $fillable = [
    'category_id', 'name', 'description', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'address',
    'price_range', 'tags', 'operating_hours', 'photo_url', 'source_type',
    'transit_friendliness_score', 'data_source_id',
    // NEW FIELDS:
    'phone', 'whatsapp', 'website',
    'google_place_id', 'google_maps_url',
    'rating', 'review_count',
    'business_status',
    'photos', 'facilities', 'payment_methods',
    'opening_hours_details', 'social_media',
    'menu_url', 'popularity', 'is_verified',
];
```

2. **Update `casts()` method with new casts:**

```php
protected function casts(): array
{
    return [
        'latitude' => 'decimal:7',
        'longitude' => 'decimal:7',
        'tags' => 'array',
        'rating' => 'decimal:1',
        'photos' => 'array',
        'facilities' => 'array',
        'payment_methods' => 'array',
        'opening_hours_details' => 'array',
        'social_media' => 'array',
        'is_verified' => 'boolean',
    ];
}
```

**Rationale:**
- `rating => decimal:1` casts to a float with 1 decimal place on serialization.
- JSON columns cast to `array` so Laravel auto-serializes/deserializes when setting/getting.
- `is_verified => boolean` ensures it returns `true`/`false` not `0`/`1`.

---

```php
        'photos' => 'array',
        'facilities' => 'array',
        'payment_methods' => 'array',
        'opening_hours_details' => 'array',
        'social_media' => 'array',
        'is_verified' => 'boolean',
    ];
}
```

**Rationale:**
- `rating => decimal:1` casts to a float with 1 decimal place on serialization.
- JSON columns cast to `array` so Laravel auto-serializes/deserializes when setting/getting.
- `is_verified => boolean` ensures it returns `true`/`false` not `0`/`1`.

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class Poi extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = [
        'category_id', 'name', 'description', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'address',
        'price_range', 'tags', 'operating_hours', 'photo_url', 'source_type',
        'transit_friendliness_score', 'data_source_id'
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'latitude' => 'decimal:7',
            'longitude' => 'decimal:7',
            'tags' => 'array',
        ];
    }

    public function category(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Category::class);
    }

    public function dataSource(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(DataSource::class);
    }

    public function transitStops(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(TransitStop::class, 'poi_transit_stops')
            ->using(PoiTransitStop::class)
            ->withPivot('distance_meters', 'walking_minutes');
    }

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsToMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

class Poi extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = [
        'category_id', 'name', 'description', 'latitude', 'longitude', 'address',
        'price_range', 'tags', 'operating_hours', 'photo_url', 'source_type',
        'transit_friendliness_score', 'data_source_id',
        'phone', 'whatsapp', 'website',
        'google_place_id', 'google_maps_url',
        'rating', 'review_count', 'business_status',
        'photos', 'facilities', 'payment_methods',
        'opening_hours_details', 'social_media',
        'menu_url', 'popularity', 'is_verified',
    ];

    protected function casts(): array
    {
        return [
            'latitude' => 'decimal:7',
            'longitude' => 'decimal:7',
            'tags' => 'array',
        ];
    }

    public function category(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Category::class);
    }

    public function dataSource(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(DataSource::class);
    }

    public function transitStops(): BelongsToMany
    {
        return $this->belongsToMany(TransitStop::class, 'poi_transit_stops')
            ->using(PoiTransitStop::class)
            ->withPivot('distance_meters', 'walking_minutes');
    }

    public function surveyActivities(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(SurveyActivity::class);
    }

    public function itineraryItems(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(ItineraryItem::class);
    }
}

The issue is that when I pass `json_encode(...)` as the value for a JSON column, Laravel's Eloquent sees it as a string, and then the `'array'` cast tries to decode it, resulting in a string being returned from the cast instead of an array.

Wait, actually looking more carefully - in the tinker output, `facilities` is `"[\"parkir_mobil\",\"toilet\",\"pemandu_wisata\",\"akses_difabel\",\"mushola\"]"` - that looks like a JSON string that was stored as-is. 

The problem: I used `json_encode()` in the seeder, but the `$casts` for these columns is `'array'`. When Laravel sees a string value being set on a model attribute with an `array` cast, it expects to receive an array and will JSON-encode it automatically when saving. But I'm passing a already-encoded JSON string. So Laravel will double-encode it.

I should pass PHP arrays directly to the create method, not json_encode values. The `array` cast will handle the JSON encoding/decoding automatically.

Let me fix the seeder to use plain PHP arrays instead of `json_encode()`.

   - Event binding: `x-on:poi-selected.window="$store.popup.open($event.detail?.poi || $event.detail)"` handles both dispatch formats
